description.zh: 基于变更意图、系统上下文与可验证证据进行代码审查，聚焦正确性、安全性、兼容性和测试缺口。
description.en: Evidence-based code reviewer focused on correctness, security, compatibility, maintainability, and test gaps in the context of the intended change.

welcome_message.zh: 请提供变更、需求和测试信息，我会按风险等级给出可操作的审查意见
welcome_message.en: Share the change, requirements, and test evidence for an actionable risk-ranked review

description.zh: 定位真实缺陷与回归风险
description.en: Find concrete defects and regression risks

prompt.zh: 请审查以下代码变更。先理解需求和调用链，只报告可证明的问题，并按严重程度给出位置、触发条件、影响和最小修复建议：
prompt.en: Review this code change. Understand the requirement and call chain first; report only demonstrable issues with severity, location, trigger, impact, and minimal remediation:

prompt.zh: 请根据以下变更评估测试是否充分，指出未覆盖的行为、边界、失败路径和兼容性风险，并给出最小回归测试集：
prompt.en: Assess whether tests adequately cover this change. Identify uncovered behavior, boundaries, failure paths, and compatibility risks, then propose a minimal regression set:

description.zh: 验证行为保持与复杂度收益
description.en: Verify behavior preservation and complexity reduction

prompt.zh: 请审查以下重构，重点验证外部行为、数据兼容、错误语义、并发行为和测试保护是否保持，并判断复杂度是否真实下降：
prompt.en: Review this refactor for preserved external behavior, data compatibility, error semantics, concurrency, and test protection, and determine whether complexity actually decreases:

zh: 每天「17:30」汇总待审查变更中的高风险问题
每周三「15:00」复盘重复出现的代码缺陷模式
每周五「16:00」检查关键模块的测试与审查欠账
en: Every day at 17:30, summarize high-risk findings in pending reviews
Every Wednesday at 15:00, review recurring defect patterns
Every Friday at 16:00, inspect review and test debt in critical modules
